name: EZIO6I
description: An Insteon controller with 6 inputs, in the EZIOxx line. Its inputs send Insteon group commands when they change.

productKeyVerification.note: Insteon Device Categories and Product Keys (October 2008) gives the key in the model's own row; the identity's conflict is only over the subcategory the EZIOxx Advanced Details give.

verification.note: Insteon Device Categories and Product Keys (October 2008) assigns 0x07/0x07 to the EZIO6I (6 inputs); the EZIOxx Advanced Details give 0x07/0x02 for EZIO as a whole. The catalog uses 0x07/0x07, the model's own entry.
The EZIOxx Advanced Details cover the whole EZIOxx line, from inputs-only to outputs-only models, and warn that a model may not support every command.

No document gives the EZIO6I's groups; input N as group N is read from the EZIOxx line's other models, and the EZIOxx Advanced Details let each input's group number be changed. That an input can be triggered as a responder is read from the EZIOxx Advanced Details, which give it for inputs 1 to 7.

notes: No document gives a model number; the profile is named for the product.

As a responder, a record whose Data 2 is 0x01 triggers the input in Data 3 (0x00 for input 1) as if it had turned on, so the input sends its own group command. No document gives a way to link one from the device.

It has opto-isolated inputs and analog inputs: the Product Guide EZEye Ambient Light Sensor —Model #1011A wires an EZEye to it as to the EZIO8SA, its digital output to an opto-isolated input (I1) and its analog output to an analog input (AN1).
